item.title: Sexual Assault Probe, Bimini School Housing, Ghana Ties
item.ns0:title: Sexual Assault Probe, Bimini School Housing, Ghana Ties
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, police launch an active investigation into a reported sexual assault involving a 17-year-old girl in the East Street South area. Aviation officials push back against major U.S. airline objections over proposed overflight fees, while Bimini leaders issue an urgent call for a modern new school and affordable housing developments. Meanwhile, construction kicks off on a new $15 million Cost Right warehouse club in New Providence, and Bahamian leaders meet with a Ghanaian envoy to strengthen economic and creative trade ties. Be sure to tune in for these headlines, a look at this year's All Bahamas Merit Scholar, highlights from the sold-out Paradise Plates fundraiser, and your complete weekend sports and weather forecast.
